projects.name: Rowte.io
projects.description: B2B fintech platform for global education commission payments — multi-currency payouts, per-enrollment reconciliation, automated document verification, and tiered partner management across agencies, sub-agents, and institutions.
stack: AWS (EC2, ALB, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudFront, ACM, Secrets Manager)

subsections.title: Actions
items: Led development of a production MVP from scratch in 3 months with a 3-person team, owning Go backend architecture, payment flows, delivery planning, and code quality
Built the Go payout engine using integer minor units, one transaction per state change, double-entry postings reversed by contra entries, and duplicate-payment guards on every payout-state transition
Implemented idempotency as Gin middleware: replayed keys return the original response, concurrent duplicates receive 409, and reused keys with changed payloads are rejected
Added a PostgreSQL transactional outbox to RabbitMQ and moved commission runs, payout notifications, and document callbacks onto Go workers and Lambda handlers
Built a rerunnable reconciliation job matching 40,000 enrollments against 38,000 payments in 45 seconds, replacing 2–3 days of spreadsheet work and categorizing breaks by cause for operations
Set up AWS CloudFront and ACM, an ALB over three EC2 targets with Nginx, and Secrets Manager; added OpenTelemetry tracing and alerts on payout-state age and outbox lag
Architected PostgreSQL schemas, service boundaries, and CI/CD pipelines for a fault-tolerant, multi-service production deployment
Implemented RBAC, MFA, and Better Auth to support secure access across agencies, sub-agents, institutions, and internal operations
Built an internal admin platform with Refine for partner management, reconciliation, document review, and operational monitoring
Handed the platform over at the end of the engagement with runbooks and a documented event catalog

subsections.title: Results
items: Delivered fully functional production MVP in 3 months as lead of a 3-person team
Zero critical financial discrepancies at launch, with duplicate-payment guards on every payout-state transition
Replaced 2–3 days of spreadsheet reconciliation with automated matching of 40,000 enrollments and 38,000 payments in 45 seconds
MFA + RBAC integration reduced unauthorized access risk to near zero
Event-driven Go services handled concurrent payout flows without data loss

subsections.title: Actions
items: Owned end-to-end integration architecture for a 7-person product team, delivering third-party integrations across support, scheduling, marketing, analytics, and learning workflows
Built Zendesk integration with embedded support chat, authentication bridging, event logging, and workflow automation, reducing median first support response from 4h10m to 1h15m
